cases.id: first placement fits the flow and paints every node, wire and control
control: a placement for another canvas changes nothing
control: nothing is painted before the canvas is placed
a second placement after the reader zoomed keeps their view
control: a second placement of an untouched view fits again
zoom in by the control doubles the zoom and keeps the centre
zoom out by the control halves the zoom and keeps the centre
zoom never passes maxZoom
zoom never passes minZoom
the wheel over the ground zooms about the pointer
control: a wheel with no turn, or off the ground, does not zoom
a drag on the ground pans and a release ends it
control: a move without a held press does not pan
control: a press on a node does not start a pan
a release on a node emits FLOW_NODE_PICKED with that node's id
control: a release on the ground does not pick a node
RASM_ACTIVATE on a node picks it
control: RASM_ACTIVATE on an unknown id does nothing
a selected node is painted with the selected look
a mark on a known node changes its look and adds its mark word
control: a mark on an unknown node changes nothing
control: a mark for another canvas changes nothing
control: a node with no mark has no mark word
FLOW_CLEAR clears every mark
control: FLOW_CLEAR for another canvas keeps the marks
a wire whose source is running is dashed with an animation
under reduced motion the live wire is dashed with no animation
control: a wire whose source is waiting is not dashed
an edge with down leaves the source's foot
a node outside the rect keeps its label id with a transparent colour
the Fit control restores the fitted view
RASM_THEME stores the looks and repaints
keyboard focus on a node shows the focus stroke and focus elsewhere clears it
control: focus on an unrelated id with nothing focused does nothing
hover enters a node and leaves it
